name: Chinese-Style Deep-Fried Salty Shrimp

ingredients.name: whole jumbo shell-on head-on shrimp, about 1 pound

instructions.primary_message: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok over medium heat until shimmering. Add the garlic, scallions and let brown, stirring occasionally, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the chile pepper flakes if using and stir until aromatic, about 30 seconds. Transfer oil and aromatics to a large metal bowl. Wipe wok clean with paper towel.

Add remaining oil to wok and heat to 190°C over medium heat. Meanwhile, combine egg and cornstarch in a medium bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat. When the oil is ready, add half of the shrimp, dropping them into the oil one at a time. Cook, agitating and flipping shrimp frequently until crisp and just cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes total. Transfer shrimp to a paper towel-lined plate and repeat with remaining batch.
Add drained fried shrimp to bowl with browned aromatics. Season to taste with salt, pepper, and optional additional seasonings. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: fried shrimp, shrimp, The Nasty Bits

description: Fried shrimp are finished with crisp green onions, garlic, chile flakes, and salt.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 teaspoon dried red chile pepper flakes (optional); 1 teaspoon five-spice powder, Old Bay, smoked paprika, Sichuan peppercorns, or a combination (optional, as desired)

Optional substitutions: peanut oil → canola oil or vegetable oil
author: Chichi Wang
